- Overestimate prices when sentiment is positive (especially >0.7) and understate when sentiment is negative (especially <0.3).  
- Overshoot after sharp upward sentiment spikes; cap forecast peaks at 10–15% below recent high if sentiment >0.8.  
- Underreact to strong negative sentiment; if sentiment < -0.2, reduce forecast by 5–10% relative to prior period.  
- Mean-revert forecasts if 3 consecutive days show >10% deviation from 14-day moving average.  
- Lagged price movements: if true outcome drops after forecast peak, reduce next forecast by 5–8% to avoid overcorrection.  
- Avoid overconfidence in 30-day horizon; if sentiment is volatile (±0.35+ in 3-day window), reduce forecast variance by 20%.
